text:
alex.ko: FYI hitting nondeterministic outputs on the eval-runner during quantized GPT-J bring-up. Repro below, seems tied to shard handoff + top_k sampling.

maria: Hmm, does this happen with float kernels too or only quantized? :thinking_face: 

alex.ko: Only quantized (int8x4) so far. Float kernels stable. Also only when top_k > 0 and top_p is 0.0 — pure top_p runs were consistent.

sam: Can you paste the exact command/config you used to run the harness?

alex.ko: ```bash
pytest tests/eval_runner/test_sampling.py::test_repro --seed=42 -k quantized -q
# runner config (snippet)
sampler:
  engine: sharded
  rng_mode: per-worker
  quant: int8x4
  sampling:
    top_k: 40
    top_p: 0.0
    temperature: 0.8
```

jin: Can you drop a short log snippet showing the differing outputs?

alex.ko: Run A: "The cat sat on the mat ."
Run B: "The cat sat in the mat ."
Different single token after sampling step ~t=14.

maria: That smells like RNG state not being serialized consistently across shard restarts or migrations. We had a related bug where the RNG "pos" index wasn't preserved.

alex.ko: I instrumented the worker to dump rng state at checkpoint and on reattach. Dumps show counters differ: worker dumps 1023 vs 998 after reattach.

sam: Is the runner using the C++ xoshiro RNG via pybind or Python's random? Also top_k can change number of random draws depending on tie-breaking and prefiltering — worth checking.

alex.ko: It's C++ xoshiro256++ (via pybind). When serializing we were writing 3 uint64 words but not the 'pos' index. So deserialization yields a different stream start. Found it while comparing raw serialized bytes.

maria: Proposed fix: make RNG serialization canonical (include pos + version). Add a unit test: serialize -> deserialize -> generate N tokens and assert identical sequence. Also add matrix CI runs exercising quant vs float kernels and top_k/top_p combos.

jin: I'll open a small PR to include the missing field and bump serialization version. Add an assert in the deserializer to reject old-format states.

deploy-bot: canary deployed: branch eng-ml/sampler-fix -> canary infra (at 1945679000).

sam: Also recommend a deterministic per-request fallback: if request.seed present, derive per-shard seeds deterministically from HMAC(request_id, global_seed) so scheduling/order doesn't affect results.

alex.ko: Added to the TODO list. Also adding specific tests for top_k behavior since prefiltering can consume draws differently; we'll run N=1000 single-token samples across top_k in CI.

maria: Filing ticket INF-2384 to track: "sampler: shard RNG serialization missing pos index causing nondet when quant + top_k".

alex.ko: Minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcdef12345 — contains a tiny harness that reproduces the mismatch by forcing a worker reattach mid-sequence.

jin: PR up in a few mins, will include unit test and compat guard.

alex.ko: Thanks all — ping me if the canary shows regressions or if you need the instrumented dump files. :eyes:
